title: Opening of the interview and date check
summary: Allen and Martyn open the session at the Watkins home and settle the date as January 20, 1961.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: This is an interview today at 832 North Galvest Street. Can I get your name?
Yeah, Joseph Watkins. And you? Barry Mountain.
And I'm Thick Allen. What's today's date?
The day is the 19th. Oh, 20th, Joe. Huh? 20th, ain't it today? No, yesterday was the 18th. I went up to the hospital yesterday. Was it the 19th? Was it the 18th? It's the 19th.
Yeah, inauguration. And you know where I had to buy that record? Where is that? In Boston.
Well, we didn't put the year. January 20th, 1961. That's right. Alright, go to it. I just want to get that on that first.
Yeah, let's put these down. Well, maybe you better begin by telling this your birth date.
